_note: Captured after two fixes to GET /kafka/topics: (1) skip enrichment for locally-scoped (localhost) bootstrap servers instead of timing out on them (PR #4), and (2) resolve the real upstream broker for destination topics from the sidecar's UPSTREAM_BROKER env var instead of the redirected localhost proxy address (PR #5, gate-institute/k8s-manager). Before these fixes this call took 80s and returned 13 topics with 7 permanently null (message_count/config) due to unreachable localhost addresses. After both fixes: 0.142s and every topic is real (source/destination pairs on the same real topic now correctly collapse into one entry).
_zero_count_note: message_count=0 for a few topics is legitimate here, not a bug: crosswalk_safety_alert/object_in_zone_detection/overspeed_alert only produce on specific detection events (short 3-minute retention means bursts age out fast between checks), and object_counting is only written by the uc4a/uc4b demo instances which are currently scaled to 0 replicas.
